title: Proof Native — Fork layout / Linear visual workbench

nativeImplementation.navigation: Native root NavigationSplitView; repository navigation plus detail-owned files/Diff/inline checked commit. Both native columns use local viewport size boundaries. No root inset overlay or guessed titlebar padding.
nativeImplementation.windowToolbar: unifiedCompact; single real active repository tab in navigation placement, open in primaryAction; no principal title badge. Native toolbar uses panel color preference. macOS26+ tab item shared background hidden; automatic title removal availability guarded.
nativeImplementation.fonts: SF system / Chinese system fallback; AppKit monospaced code13pt,22pt lines; offline
nativeImplementation.language: Chinese app-owned UI; source code, repository metadata and backend diagnostics retain original values.

treeBehavior.scope: Both staged and unstaged groups; compressed folders, search and collapse
treeBehavior.selection: Soft neutral-purple row; not a review approval
treeBehavior.metadata: Status letter, manual review check for loaded content, known selected snapshot additions/deletions

reviewCoverage.source: Bridge-returned loaded snapshots; explicit synthetic fixture only in preview
reviewCoverage.safety: Content-bound review remains independent of staging and checked commit

nativeImplementation.repositoryTabBehavior: One active repository, not multi-repo support. Closing/replacing protects unsaved commit message; failed open preserves draft.

contextInspector.validation: Not reported by this frontend; no fabricated AI/session/test evidence

nativeImplementation.inlineCommit: Real staged count and shared canPrepareCommit guard; preview/confirmation remains mandatory; no implicit push or amend.

narrative.northStar: Fork’s repository/files/diff workflow, Linear’s quiet gray hierarchy; preserve real Proof safety.
narrative.overview: Full approved concept supersedes prior native directions, not original Web/Tauri. Compact repository tab chrome, navigation, partitioned files, solid code and inline checked commit. Unavailable concept features are omitted honestly.
keyCharacteristics: Inline checked commit and independent human review
dos: Follow current approved full concept hierarchy.
Use actual repository metadata and loaded snapshot coverage.
Verify new native captures rather than reusing prior acceptance.
donts: Do not fake unavailable Git controls.
Do not imply unknown content was reviewed.
Do not reintroduce large empty titlebar or title capsule.
Do not treat concept approval as runtime or aesthetic acceptance.
